title: Tenant schema, RBAC và private projections
scope_items: Canonical Goose SQL migration (infra/migrations/00001_p0_04_tenant_schema_rls_and_grants.sql) with NOLOGIN role hierarchy (app_user, admin_user, outbox_poller, directory_reader), core and slice tenant tables, direct-junction tables (trend_signals, opportunity_sources, idea_sources, taggables, bundle_items, support_ticket_messages) with workspace_id, composite same-tenant foreign keys (database_schema.md §26.11), single-active-owner invariant (fk_workspaces_owner + idx_one_active_workspace_owner, §26.14), immutable evidence trigger protect_evidence_content() (§26.13), ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY policies, and narrow per-role grants (§26.12, §27.2)
Goose migration runner and static SQL contract validator (apps/api/internal/migrate) plus cmd/migrate entrypoint preserving fail-closed exit code 2 when unconfigured

Transaction-scoped tenant DB execution wrapper (apps/api/internal/tenantdb.WithTx) setting SET LOCAL ROLE app_user, app.current_tenant_id, and app.current_user_id, verifying active membership inside the transaction, rolling back on error or panic, and enforcing exact NUMERIC(18,6) decimal arithmetic (ExactDecimal) while rejecting float32/float64 (DB-H-001)

Canonical RBAC matrix (161 workspace permissions × 7 roles + 28 internal admin permissions × 8 roles) and 1,188 RPC permission bindings loader/authorizer (apps/api/internal/rbac) with constraint evaluators for external_contributor shared/assigned rules, own-draft rules, approval state transitions, and admin impersonation prohibitions

Workspace and member management service (apps/api/internal/workspace) implementing Create, Get, Update, ListMembers, UpdateRole, and RemoveMember with atomic single-owner transfer, last-owner protection, synchronous member revocation enforcement, idempotency replay/conflict handling, and private response projections stripping encrypted tokens, key hashes, internal support notes (is_internal_note = true), and private media_kit draft sections
Web Team & RBAC screen (/settings/team, W115/W116) and client RBAC/revocation projection helpers (apps/web/src/lib/auth/rbac.ts)
verified_sub_slices: 268 Up statements and 49 Down statements in 00001_p0_04_tenant_schema_rls_and_grants.sql validated with pglast PostgreSQL AST parser and static contract validator
Two-tenant and direct-junction isolation verified via composite FKs, RLS policies, and WithTx scope checks
Last-owner protection and atomic ownership transfer verified in workspace.Service and UI guards
Immediate member revocation enforcement verified on next request and mid-session workspace reconciliation (EC-AUTH-003)

Private notes and secrets stripping verified across ConnectedAccountProjection, APIKeyProjection, WebhookSubscriptionProjection, SupportTicketMessageProjection, PublicCreatorProfileProjection, and AssertNoSecretsOrPrivateNotesSerialized
ExactDecimal NUMERIC(18,6) arithmetic and float32/float64 rejection verified (DB-H-001)

161 workspace permissions and 28 internal admin permissions verified cell-for-cell against docs/04_contracts/rbac_permission_matrix.md and all 1,188 rows of docs/04_contracts/rpc_permission_bindings.csv

cd apps/api && go mod verify && go vet ./...

remaining_scope: CI PostgreSQL 17.10 live execution of TestPostgresLiveMigrationAndAppUserRLS, TestPostgresLiveWithTxIsolationAndRollback, and TestPostgresLiveWorkspaceOwnerProtectionRevocationAndProjections via tooling/ci/check_identity.sh (no local PostgreSQL daemon in worker container)
P0-05 ConnectRPC handler mounting and end-to-end RBAC/idempotency interceptor wiring on cmd/api and cmd/admin-api
Independent GitHub Actions CI green run and security review before ACCEPTED status
decisions: Created canonical Goose SQL migration 00001_p0_04_tenant_schema_rls_and_grants.sql with NOLOGIN roles (app_user, admin_user, outbox_poller, directory_reader), composite same-tenant FKs (§26.11), single-active-owner constraint (§26.14), immutable evidence trigger (§26.13), ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all tenant and junction tables, and narrow table/column grants (§26.12, §27.2).

Implemented tenantdb.WithTx and ExactDecimal in apps/api/internal/tenantdb so every tenant query runs inside a transaction with SET LOCAL ROLE app_user, app.current_tenant_id, and app.current_user_id, verifies active membership, rolls back on error or panic, and rejects float money conversions.

Generated apps/api/internal/rbac/matrix.go directly from docs/04_contracts/rbac_permission_matrix.md (161 workspace permissions × 7 roles + 28 admin permissions × 8 roles) and bound all 1,188 RPCs from docs/04_contracts/rpc_permission_bindings.csv.

Implemented apps/api/internal/workspace Service and Projections enforcing last-owner protection, atomic single-transaction ownership transfer, immediate member revocation, and private projections stripping secrets and internal admin notes.
Wired live PostgreSQL 17.10 execution of ./internal/migrate, ./internal/tenantdb, ./internal/rbac, and ./internal/workspace into tooling/ci/check_identity.sh.
notes: P0-04 implementation and all local static/unit/race/web/mobile/proto/transport checks are complete (LOCAL_IMPLEMENTED). Live PostgreSQL 17.10 execution is wired into tooling/ci/check_identity.sh for GitHub Actions CI.
